evals.name: redact-customer-data
evals.prompt: Redact customer payment cards, passwords, and tax IDs before logging HTTP request payloads and responses.
evals.expected_output: Logging interceptor or marshaler masking sensitive fields using regex or custom struct tags.
assertions: Masks credit card numbers showing only last 4 digits (e.g. '****-****-****-1234').
Completely redacts passwords, CVV codes, and private keys.
Ensures raw unmasked payloads are never emitted in production logs or traces.

evals.name: encrypt-pii-at-rest
evals.prompt: Store customer national identification numbers in PostgreSQL while complying with data privacy regulations.
evals.expected_output: Application-level envelope encryption before database write and decryption on read.
assertions: Encrypts sensitive field at application layer before passing to database.
Stores encrypted ciphertext and initialization vector / nonce in database column.
Encryption keys are managed securely and rotated independently of database backups.

evals.name: sanitize-test-fixtures
evals.prompt: Review integration test fixtures containing real customer names, phone numbers, and live API tokens.
evals.expected_output: Replacement with synthetic, anonymized test fixtures using faker or standard dummy values.
assertions: Removes real customer names, phone numbers, and emails from test files.
Replaces live API keys with dummy mock tokens.
Ensures test repository contains zero production secrets or real PII.
